restaurant_name: ทันตกรรมบ้านฟันดีเพิ่มสิน 17
text: The dental work itself is good, but the service is a bit lacking in manners. I usually arrive on time for my appointments, often waiting 1-2 hours. It's rare that I'm late. Once, I was 20 minutes late due to an errand and kept calling. When I arrived, they just stared at me as if they wanted to rush home at 5:30 PM (the clinic's Facebook page or storefront states closing time is 8 PM). They asked me what time my appointment was, even though I'd already informed them I'd be late, calling at 11 AM and mentioning traffic beforehand. They could have simply suggested rescheduling or changing the date if they couldn't wait. It was quite disappointing.

restaurant_name: ทันตกรรมบ้านฟันดีเพิ่มสิน 17
text: The patient scheduling system needs improvement. There are hundreds of patients a day, and scheduling everyone for 1 PM is impossible. We always arrive on time, sometimes even early, but we still have to wait at least 1-2 hours. Sometimes, even arriving early doesn't get us priority. We're told the doctor starts at 10 AM, and we want to get done quickly, so we arrive at 10 AM, but by 10:30 AM the doctor still hasn't arrived. Another example: A 3 PM appointment, with the doctor said to be available from 3-6 PM, but we arrived at 2:44 PM because we had other errands to run, and the doctor only arrived two minutes later, at 4 PM. We didn't get our teeth done until almost 5 PM. We couldn't do anything else that day. For three years, we've spent every month just waiting for the doctor. I've talked to friends who are also getting braces at other clinics, and none of them have to wait like we do. I really want this issue to be addressed; it's terrible.

text:
If there were a 0-star rating, I would have given it. The orthodontic treatment didn't follow the advertised schedule. I paid in full, but they insisted on continuing the treatment regardless of what was correct.
What's the point of advertising a promotion then?
Regarding the orthodontics, after I paid in full, they wanted to remove the braces immediately, even though my teeth were still crowded and crooked.
Completely unethical. In short, they scheduled the removal even though my teeth weren't properly aligned, and they charged an additional 2,000 baht for removal.
And another 5,000 baht for retainers. Extremely expensive.
In the end, I had to go elsewhere to have them removed. Even the other dentist commented on why they rushed the removal when my teeth weren't even aligned yet.
I'm so confused. This is the worst experience I've ever had.
Please think carefully and choose your clinic wisely, everyone! 🥹
author_name: ธิดานันท์ จิตหมั่น

text: The front desk service was terrible, especially the older staff who were unwelcoming. The doctor and his assistants, however, were good.

restaurant_name: ทันตกรรมบ้านฟันดีเพิ่มสิน 17
text: Doctors should have ethical standards and should not mention another patient to patients undergoing procedures, whether good or bad. From what I've heard, I see it as a comparison. Not everyone is equally good at making excuses. Some people don't even have to open their mouths to fight for their lives. If doctors are so lazy about accepting patients that they don't want to go to the clinic, they should just close the clinic.

text: I went for a dental scaling today. The doctor was very nice and kind and patient. The person who worked with the doctor was also lovely. The receptionist was very polite and lovely. This was my first time using the service and I was very impressed. I will definitely come back again.

restaurant_name: ทันตกรรมบ้านฟันดีเพิ่มสิน 17
text: I went to get an X-ray of my wisdom teeth. The doctor pushed the film so hard that my tongue got sore. He also said to me that I was tense and the film wasn't clear. Other places do it clearly, but no matter how much it hurts, I can endure it. But here, he pushed so hard that I almost threw up. He also pulled the film out of my mouth, causing my mouth to fill with saliva.
